_about: 美联储是否在 2026-01-31 前的 FOMC 会议上降息的冻结证据包（负例）。信息截至 2025-12-31。

evidence.title: Implementation Note issued December 10, 2025
evidence.excerpt: the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 3-1/2 to 3-3/4 percent.
evidence.claim: 12 月已降息一次，1 月是否继续降息未定；会后沟通偏向观望。

evidence.title: Fed cuts interest rates in December 2025 as Powell hints at a pause
evidence.excerpt: Fed cuts interest rates in December 2025 as Powell hints at a pause
evidence.claim: 市场普遍解读为可能暂停，1 月降息的概率并不高但并非为零。

evidence.title: Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement (December 10, 2025)
evidence.excerpt: the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 3-1/2 to 3-3/4 percent.
evidence.claim: 官方声明确认 12 月降息；是否继续宽松未定。

evidence.title: Fed meeting live: December interest rate decision and 2026 outlook
evidence.excerpt: Fed meeting live: December interest rate decision and 2026 outlook
evidence.claim: 媒体聚焦 2026 年路径，说明 1 月是否降息并无定论。
